{{Top}}
[[File:Aquarium-POP.png|thumb|right|250px|Senator Christo's aquarium on Coruscant]]
{{Quote|Ah, here we are. Here it is. A pocket-sized aquarium. Wonderful, isn't it? And, you can take it with you anywhere. And the tank is a snap to clean.|Saun Dann|<ref name="SWHS">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>}}
An '''aquarium''', also known as a '''fish tank''', was a transparent [[Water/Legends|water]]-filled container in which living [[Fish/Legends|fishes]] and other aquatic animals or [[Plant/Legends|plants]] were kept. Aquariums served as exhibition areas, either as large buildings or as personal decorations.

Typically constructed of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] panels, such tanks came in many shapes, the most common being cuboid structures.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> Bowl-shaped containers called '''fishbowls''' existed as well.<ref name="SW74">[[Star Wars (1977) 74|''Star Wars'' (1977) 74]]</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] had one in her apartment on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Christo/Legends|Christo]] also had an aquarium in his apartment on Coruscant. The [[Dubrillion Aquarium]] was another famous example; [[Shedao Shai]] used it as his base of operations during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. [[Cha Niathal]] had an aquarium in her home on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]; she committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] there by filling her aquarium's tank with [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] monoxide.

One type of aquarium was a [[Pocket-sized aquarium|miniaturized aquarium]] that would fit in a pocket and was very easy to clean. The merchant [[Saun Dann]] sold such pocket-sized tanks in his [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyykian]] [[Trading post Wookiee Planet C|trading post]], and the local [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were fond of such items, which Dann considered "stupid stuff." Dann once tried to sell a miniaturized fish tank to an off-duty [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] guard, who bluntly declared that he hated fishes.<ref name="SWHS" />
